attempts.why: Pricing table has min-width:640px with no scroll container, causing horizontal overflow and layout break at 375px viewport; adding overflow-x:auto makes it responsively scrollable without hiding content.

selfVerify.reason: At 375px viewport no horizontal overflow/page break is visible – text wraps, buttons and card fit within width, header intact. Pricing table is below the fold and not visible in this screenshot, but the visible layout shows no overflow or clipped content, consistent with overflow-x:auto making the 640px table scrollable within its container.
